page.overview:
Who is Belle?

Belle is an aunt of Jenny and a senior who lives in Springfield Retirement Castle. She makes her first and only appearance in "The Good, the Sad and the Drugly."

When Bart first met Jenny, he started reflecting about her. When he stopped, he was shocked by seeing an older version Jenny. However, it turned out that it was actually Jenny's aunt Belle who wore the same clothes as Jenny.
